title: 2-minute thought check
steps: Write down the thought bothering you
What is the evidence for it?
What is the evidence against it?
What would you tell a friend who had this thought?

title: One small step
steps: Pick one task that takes under 5 minutes (drink water, open a window, step outside)

title: Reach out to someone
steps: Think of one person you feel even a little safe with
Send them a short message, even just 'hey, thinking of you'
You don't have to explain everything

title: Three good things
steps: Write down three things that went okay today, however small
For one of them, note why it happened
